chunks.text: But now it doesn't seem to matter very much. My uncle was delighted. For myself, moody and dissatisfied, I appeared almost to expect a glimpse of the ghost of Hamlet. Mr Morton seemed particularly struck with the account of Waverley's visit to Donald being lean. Give me my horse and arms, and wait for me here. I will go in quest of this knight, and dead or alive, I will make him keep his word plighted to so great a beauty. It was written in the upper Rangatada district of the Canterbury Province, as it then was of New Zealand.
and appeared at Christchurch in the press newspaper, june thirteenth, eighteen sixty three.

I will go in quest of this knight, and dead or alive, I will make him keep his word plighted to so great a beauty. It was written in the upper Rangatada district of the Canterbury Province, as it then was of New Zealand, and appeared at Christchurch in the press newspaper, June 13, 1863.
